1.0.0.summary: First public release: on-device voice control, karaoke lyrics, podcasts, full physical controls.
1.0.0.changelog:
First public release of Mira.

- 100% on-device voice control ("hey mira" play/queue/volume/transport)
- Album art + synced lyrics with karaoke word-by-word highlighting
- Podcast support with synced transcripts
- Full physical controls: volume knob, 4 presets, back, power menu
- Device picker, Liked Songs saving, multi-phone Bluetooth pairing
- Internet via Bluetooth tether (phone) or USB tether (Windows/Mac/Linux)
